facts.value: The source declares it_803F79A0 as an array of two ItemStateTable records. Their anim_id fields are 0 and 1; both animated fields reference itGamewatchpanic_UnkMotion1_Anim, and both physics_updated and collided fields are NULL. Pickup selects row index 0 for GA_Ground and row index 1 otherwise. The row index is the requested motion state; the leading field is its animation ID, not a stored motion-state identifier.

facts.value: Resolves the supplied article's Item and reads its owner. A NULL owner yields true without invoking either fighter helper. With an owner, it passes that fighter to ftGw_SpecialLw_ItemCheckPanicRemove: false yields false without cleanup; true causes a fresh Item lookup, an owner-null check, and owner forwarding to ftGw_SpecialLw_ItemPanicSetFlag when still present, followed by true. Fighter cleanup requests exit from hitlag for the tracked Panic article before clearing the tracked pointer and damage/death callbacks.
